market_summary: During the late New York session, major assets display broad bearish trends relative to daily VWAP and EMA50 baselines, but momentum has stalled on below-average volume (RVOL < 1.0). FX pairs (EURUSD, GBPUSD) and metals (XAUUSD, XAGUSD) are resting directly above session low support and lower ATR envelopes without yellow breakout volume confirmation. US100 is rebounding into dealer Call Wall resistance within a positive dampening gamma regime, precluding long continuation. BTCUSD remains range-bound inside its session value area near the POC magnet. Disciplined execution warrants HOLD across all assets pending volume expansion.
